action_items: Rework dashboard bootstrap cancellation to eliminate aborted dashboard GET noise during immediate route exits (current 350ms delay + timer cleanup is insufficient in live flow).
Gate dashboard bootstrap with route-focus/active-screen guard and/or add AbortController-aware request handling so intentional route change does not surface aborted request failures.
Re-run this exact desktop+phone rapid navigation scenario after fix and verify zero aborted dashboard GETs and zero aborted /api/followups/reconcile.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.tsx delays initial load via setTimeout(350) and clears timer on unmount, but once timer fires load() starts multiple GETs without explicit cancellation semantics; rapid route change still yields browser-level net::ERR_ABORTED for dashboard reads.
No auto reconcile mutation regression observed: /api/followups/reconcile abort count remained 0 across tested rapid navigation runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials used from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (owner@forge.app). Critical failure reproduced in 3 rapid-nav desktop runs and 1 rapid-nav phone run: dashboard GET aborts persist. Tile Orders tabs + customer grid still load after settling (rows present on both desktop and phone).
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: login -> immediately navigate dashboard to Tile Orders, then rapidly bounce dashboard <-> Tile Orders. Observed consistent net::ERR_ABORTED on dashboard bootstrap GETs (followups mission/list, dashboard stats, payments stats), while reconcile POST aborts remained zero and console error count remained zero. Likely root cause: timer cleanup only prevents not-yet-started bootstrap; once timer fires, in-flight dashboard reads can still be interrupted by navigation and appear as aborted failures.
